name: sitescout-report-chat
description: Answers a follow-up question about an already-run SiteScout store-location analysis (why a zone ranks where it does, what a score breakdown means, what a risk implies). Every number in the answer is checked against the analysis data it was given; if it can't produce a grounded answer, it says so instead of guessing. Send one JSON object: {question, city, category, tier, zones}, where zones is the analysis's own top zones with their scores, contributions, drivers and risks.

skills.name: Explain a store-location analysis
skills.description: Given a question and the top zones of an already-scored analysis (scores, score breakdowns, drivers, risks and narratives), answers in 3 to 5 sentences using only the numbers it was given.
